stories.title: 83-year-old Ohio woman dies after Wayne County crash
stories.summary: The crash happened Nov. 20 north of Richmond, Indiana.

stories.title: Construction worker finds crashed car on closed portion of I-70 in Richmond, driver later pronounced dead
stories.summary: Investigators believe the vehicle may have been at the crash location for "an extended period before being discovered," according to the WCSO.

stories.title: IMPD asks for help locating 9-year-old boy, 25-year-old woman who doesn't have legal custody of him
stories.summary: ​Nine-year-old Jaxson Totton is believed to be with 25-year-old Makayla Bowman, who police said does not have legal custody of him.

stories.title: 'We could lose bobcats from Indiana within a decade' | New 400 Bobcat quota reached, environmentalist warn of population loss
stories.summary: On Nov. 21, Indiana closed its trapping season after it exceeded its 400-bobcat quota for the season that began on Nov. 8. The new quota is a 60% increase from 2025.

stories.title: 2 children killed, 4 others hurt in head-on crash in Randolph County
stories.summary: According to Indiana State Police, two children died from their injuries, two other kids were seriously hurt and two drivers were also injured.

stories.title: Toddler, 10-year-old die in Grant County house fire
stories.summary: The fire was reported around 10:30 p.m. Nov. 22 on East South G Street in Gas City.

stories.title: 'A long recovery' | Gov. Braun announces additional FEMA assistance, temporary travel trailer program
stories.summary: Not all households whose homes were affected by the historic August storms and flooding will be eligible for the travel trailer program.

stories.title: Indiana food pantry helping families in need with food around the holidays
stories.summary: Hunger, Inc. has provided food to those in need since 1983. Their service area includes Perry Township, Franklin Township and a portion of Beech Grove.

stories.title: Owen County teen pleads guilty to shooting and killing his father and great uncle
stories.summary: Jeremiah Dill pleaded guilty but mentally ill to two counts of murder. He was just 15 years old at the time of the August 2025 shooting.

stories.title: Investigation underway after 74-year-old woman, 39-year-old man found dead inside northwest Indiana home
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said deputies responded to a residence in the 4000 block of North County Road 800 East in rural La Porte late Friday night for a welfare check.

stories.title: 2 men arrested for alleged roles in over 35 burglaries involving theft of rent checks across Indianapolis
stories.summary: According to IMPD, in early March, the men started their string of business burglaries across Indianapolis' northwest side.

stories.title: Avon man convicted of attempted murder for shooting at officers sentenced to 100 years
stories.summary: Marquis Virgil reportedly called police in December 2025 to get officers to come to an Avon home so he could shoot them.
